description: Defines the SharedBuffer class for inter-process shared memory communication with semaphore synchronization, including constructors, methods for producing and consuming data, and accessors for administration data.

classes.name: SharedBuffer
classes.description: A class facilitating shared memory buffer with semaphore-based synchronization for inter-process communication.

methods.name: RequestProduce
methods.description: Locks the producer semaphore, indicating readiness to produce data.

methods.name: Produced
methods.description: Unlocks the consumer semaphore after data has been produced and updates bytes written.

methods.name: RequestConsume
methods.description: Locks the consumer semaphore, indicating readiness to consume data, and realigns buffer size.

methods.name: Consumed
methods.description: Unlocks the producer semaphore after data has been consumed and updates bytes written.

methods.name: AdministrationBuffer
methods.description: Returns pointer to the administration buffer.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written in the shared buffer.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Gets user permissions for the shared buffer.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Gets group permissions for the shared buffer.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Gets permission mode for the shared buffer.
